paragraphs: R. Nasa, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 3, end of mishnah 1. 'Many times I ate with R. Taḥlifa and Ininyah'—Jerusalem Talmud, end of Sanhedrin 2: R. Ḥanina—'bar Sisi, my uncle, and he did not include me in the zimmun until I grew two hairs,' Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 7, mishnah 2. R. Nasa in R. Elazar's name, there, Dinei Mamonot [פד״מ, provisional], halakhah 13; Shevi'it 4, halakhah 2. In R. Bun bar Ḥiyya's name, HaGozel Batra, halakhah 5. In R. Yonah's name and R. Yose bar Ḥanina's name, beginning of HaMafkid. R. Yonah in his name, Osin Passin. R. Nisa said he did not know his father; his mother told him his father said one may light Ḥanukkah lamps with oil due for burning, end of Terumot. R. Redifa'ah in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Eruvin 1.
